user.title: SpinJam
user.description: Select the media players SpinJam should watch. Put higher-priority sources first. When a Sonos/Port source is Line-in, SpinJam uses the vinyl player instead. Optionally pick one or more Cast/TV displays.

data.name: Name
data.lyric_offset_ms: Lyric display offset (ms; positive = lyrics later)

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one SpinJam instance is allowed.

error.no_sources: Select at least one source media player.
error.displays_not_cast: Every display must be a Google Cast media_player (entity registry platform = cast).
error.invalid_path: Dashboard path must be a lowercase slug that contains a hyphen (e.g. spinjam-tv).
error.invalid_dashboard_path: Dashboard path must be a lowercase slug that contains a hyphen (e.g. spinjam-tv).
error.invalid_sync_offset: Playback sync offset must be between -2000 and 2000 ms.
error.invalid_lyric_offset: Lyric display offset must be between -5000 and 5000 ms.

init.title: SpinJam options
init.description: Update sources, displays, lyric timing, and Cast options. Defaults: dashboard_path=spinjam-tv, view_path=now. Prefer Google Cast media_players. Call spinjam.create_dashboard once or create the dashboard manually (see docs/TV_CAST.md).

data.name: Name
data.lyric_offset_ms: Lyric display offset (ms; positive = lyrics later)
data.dashboard_path: Cast dashboard path (must include a hyphen)
data.recast_on_startup: Re-cast on Home Assistant restart if Cast was on
data.power_off_display_on_stop: Power off display when stopping (default off; Cast quit leaves TV on)

error.no_sources: Select at least one source media player.
error.displays_not_cast: Every display must be a Google Cast media_player (entity registry platform = cast).
error.invalid_path: Dashboard path must be a lowercase slug that contains a hyphen (e.g. spinjam-tv).
error.invalid_sync_offset: Playback sync offset must be between -2000 and 2000 ms.
error.invalid_lyric_offset: Lyric display offset must be between -5000 and 5000 ms.
error.invalid_recast_interval: Re-cast interval must be between 15 and 300 seconds.

start.name: Start SpinJam display
start.description: Start a SpinJam display session (optional built-in Cast) and fire spinjam_start. Same as turning on switch.spinjam_cast.

display.name: Display
display.description: Optional configured media_player to cast to.

stop.name: Stop SpinJam display
stop.description: End the SpinJam display session and fire spinjam_stop. Same as turning off switch.spinjam_cast.

create_dashboard.name: Create SpinJam dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Create or update the storage-mode Lovelace dashboard (panel view + SpinJam card) used for Cast.

dashboard_path.name: Dashboard path
dashboard_path.description: Lovelace url_path (must include a hyphen). Defaults to options / spinjam-tv.

view_path.name: View path
view_path.description: View path inside the dashboard. Defaults to now.
